name: capture-session-baseline
description: Record the session ids that already exist so a case can delete only what it creates. Deletes nothing: the operator's sessions are never a test's to remove.

metadata.name: capture-session-baseline
metadata.description: Record the session ids that already exist so a case can delete only what it creates. Deletes nothing: the operator's sessions are never a test's to remove.

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const listIds = async () => { try { const res = await fetch('/vrooli.web_console.v1.sessions.SessionsService/List', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}', cache: 'no-store' }); if (!res.ok) return null; const body = await res.json(); const rows = Array.isArray(body) ? body : (body && body.sessions) || []; return rows.map((s) => s && s.id).filter(Boolean); } catch { return null; } }; const ids = await listIds(); if (ids) { try { sessionStorage.setItem('__bas_baseline_sessions', JSON.stringify(ids)); } catch {} } window.__bas_baseline_sessions = ids || []; document.body.setAttribute('data-bas-baseline-count', String((ids || []).length)); document.body.setAttribute('data-bas-baseline-ready', ids === null ? 'false' : 'true'); })()
